description: Two German children load and the supplied tiebreaker list is de:[de-CH, de-AT] — the REVERSE of both the file-write order and alphabetical order. Added by review: it makes the CONTENT of a tiebreaker entry observable, which is what gives the absent-vs-present pair its meaning. The existing seed row 2 (direct-fr-be, fr:[fr-FR, fr-CA]) rules out alphabetical order only; it cannot rule out a port that follows manifest insertion order, because there the two coincide. Here they do not.
